title: Fix _answer_current_question helper can't fill CIDR/URL target when wizard is in tile-based flow after advanced pre-selection
goal: In _answer_current_question, before raising AssertionError, add a fallback check: if the answer looks like a CIDR (contains '/') or a URL (starts with 'https://'), try filling wizard-target-input if it is visible. Alternatively, in the test loop, add a check for wizard-target-input visibility before calling _answer_current_question. The simplest fix: add a check in _answer_current_question that if wizard-target-input is visible, fills it with the answer and returns.
scope: test_assessment_mode_internal_lan_surfaces_chain_progress fails with 'AssertionError: No visible answer input or mapped tile available for answer: 10.0.20.0/24'. The test uses wizard-advanced-toggle to pre-select assessment type ('Internal Range / LAN') and assessment mode ('FULL-INTERNAL-LAN'), then enters a loop trying to answer wizard questions. The loop correctly tries _complete_mockup_target_depth_step (which handles the tile-based wizard-target-card + wizard-target-input + wizard-depth-tile flow), but when that returns False (no wizard-target-card visible), falls through to _answer_current_question('10.0.20.0/24'). The _answer_current_question function does not have a path for filling wizard-target-input with a CIDR/URL value — it only handles tile mapping and the conversational conversation-answer-input.

inputs.root_cause: _answer_current_question checks for assessment tile mapping and conversational answer input but not for wizard-target-input (the tile-based target field visible in step 2). When the wizard has been pre-configured via the advanced panel and is showing the target/depth card, _complete_mockup_target_depth_step should have returned True, but the wizard might be in a different rendering state that shows wizard-target-input without wizard-target-card being visible.
